decision_summary: Profile and teacher-owned classroom foundations are authorized. Invite and membership persistence contracts are authorized, but invite issuance/resolution and membership mutation endpoints remain policy-gated until invite reuse/expiry and learner multi-classroom rules are approved. Learning sessions and all scientific behavior remain prohibited.

authentication_contract.subject_mapping: A verified Supabase subject maps uniquely to app_users.supabase_subject.
authentication_contract.email_storage: Do not duplicate authenticated email in profile tables; return it only from a verified current token contract when required.
authentication_contract.profile_cardinality: One app_users row may select exactly one immutable profile_type after onboarding: LEARNER or TEACHER. It may not hold both profiles.

ownership_rules: One teacher may own multiple classrooms.
Each classroom belongs to exactly one teacher profile.
Each classroom has exactly one grade.
Each classroom may have multiple approved learners.
A learner enters a classroom only through a classroom membership record.
A learner controls only their own learner profile and membership view.
A teacher controls only their own teacher profile and owned classrooms.
A teacher may view or decide membership only for classrooms they own.
A teacher may view learner identity only through an APPROVED membership in an owned classroom.
A learner may not access another learner's profile, membership, session, or progress data.
Possession of an opaque UUID or invite token is never sufficient authorization.

classroom_grade_rules.selected_by: The owning teacher selects grade during classroom creation.
classroom_grade_rules.learner_context: An approved membership inherits its learning context from classroom.grade.
classroom_grade_rules.existing_b_learners_grade: Not client-writable and not authoritative for classroom context in this scope; do not synchronize or overwrite it until grade-change semantics are approved.

app_users.purpose: Unique verified Supabase-subject account root and immutable profile-type discriminator.
app_users.ownership: Self account, controlled by verified subject; no password or token ownership.
permitted_new_fields: profile_type nullable until first profile creation, then LEARNER or TEACHER and immutable
required_constraints: profile_type is null, LEARNER, or TEACHER
app_users.privacy: Store the Supabase subject and minimum operational account state only.

b_learners.purpose: The single operational LEARNER profile; no duplicate learner_profiles table is authorized.
b_learners.ownership: Exactly one LEARNER app user through app_user_learner_links in this limited scope.
required_constraints: name is nonblank after trimming and bounded in length
grade remains nullable and, if present, 2 or 3
profile create does not accept grade
b_learners.lifecycle_limits: Create and read own profile only; update and deactivate are not authorized.

app_user_learner_links.purpose: Maps a LEARNER app user to their own b_learners profile; teacher visibility uses classroom_memberships instead.
required_constraints: one learner profile per LEARNER account in this scope
one owning LEARNER account per learner profile in this scope
TEACHER accounts cannot have this link
app_user_learner_links.prohibited_use: Must not encode classroom membership or teacher access.

teacher_profiles.purpose: Minimum TEACHER profile distinct from learner and authentication records.
teacher_profiles.ownership: Exactly one TEACHER app user owns the row.
teacher_profiles.privacy: No email copy; email is obtained only from the verified current authentication contract.
teacher_profiles.lifecycle_limits: Create and read own profile only; update and deactivate are not authorized.

classrooms.purpose: Teacher-owned classroom and its single Grade 2 or Grade 3 context.
classrooms.privacy: Classroom responses expose no teacher email or learner data.
classrooms.lifecycle_limits: Create and read only; grade change, transfer, archive, and delete are not authorized.

classroom_invites.purpose: Revocable secure invitation reference for QR presentation; never a classroom identifier grant.
audit_requirements: invite creation and revocation audit events
classroom_invites.privacy: Persist only a one-way token hash; raw token is returned once for QR construction and never logged.
prohibited_fields: classroom_id encoded as the sole QR secret
classroom_invites.lifecycle_limits: Schema may be implemented, but invite creation and resolution remain disabled until expiry-duration and cross-learner reuse policy are approved.

classroom_memberships.purpose: Learner request and teacher decision for one classroom.
classroom_memberships.ownership: Learner owns request visibility; classroom owner controls approval or rejection.
required_checks: state is PENDING, APPROVED, or REJECTED
PENDING has no decision timestamp or decider
APPROVED and REJECTED require decision timestamp and owning-teacher decider
audit_requirements: request, approval, and rejection audit events
classroom_memberships.privacy: Teacher lists expose only minimum learner ID and name for memberships in an owned classroom.
classroom_memberships.lifecycle_limits: Only PENDING to APPROVED or PENDING to REJECTED is contemplated; mutation endpoints remain disabled until learner multi-classroom behavior and invite reuse policy are approved.

qr_invite_rules: The QR payload contains a random unguessable invite token, never a raw classroom database ID.
Persist only a safely derived token hash; never persist or log the raw token.
The token format, entropy construction, and cryptographic implementation are not selected by this authorization.
Invites must support revocation and may support expiry; expired or revoked invitations fail closed.
The payload exposes no teacher email, learner data, database identifier, credential, or secret other than the opaque invite capability.
Resolving or scanning an invite never grants APPROVED membership.
A scan may create only a PENDING request after authenticated learner ownership checks.
Duplicate request commands require idempotent replay.
Cross-learner invite reuse and expiry duration remain unresolved; live invite issuance and resolution fail closed until approved.

endpoint_common_contract.state_changing_commands: Require Idempotency-Key and atomic idempotency persistence.
endpoint_common_contract.privacy: No password, token, raw JWT claim set, direct auth subject, research identifier, or scientific field is returned.

idempotency_requirements: Every authorized or future-unblocked POST requires an opaque Idempotency-Key.
Scope by verified actor_user_id, HTTP method, route operation identifier, and key.
Persist canonical request fingerprint and committed response atomically with mutation.
Identical replay returns the original response; different-body reuse returns stable CONFLICT.
Raw invite token must not appear in logs, audit payloads, canonical response storage beyond the one-time response, or diagnostic details.
audit_requirements: Append audit events for profile creation, classroom creation, invite creation/revocation, membership request, approval, and rejection.
Record verified actor, request ID, operation, reason code, resource, before/after references or versions, timestamp, environment, schema revision, and approval evidence when applicable.
Teacher learner-list access must be attributable without logging names, emails, tokens, or learner data.
Audit events are append-only and never contain raw JWT, Authorization header, raw invite token, password, scientific fields, or research identifiers.

provenance_rules.live_mutations: Server assigns source_class REAL; clients cannot submit or override provenance.
provenance_rules.actor: actor_user_id comes only from verified Supabase subject mapping.
provenance_rules.test_isolation: TEST and SYNTHETIC are allowed only in isolated test environments with visibly non-real identities.

privacy_constraints: Store only minimum teacher and learner names plus authentication and ownership references needed for this flow.
Authenticated email may be returned from the verified token contract but is not duplicated in teacher_profiles or b_learners.
Backend stores no passwords, raw JWTs, refresh tokens, or Supabase service credentials.
Raw invite tokens are never logged or persisted.
Teacher access is limited to owned classrooms and learners with APPROVED membership in those classrooms.
Learner access is limited to their own profile and membership records.
No research export or operational-to-research identity join is authorized.
No synthetic data may enter live profile or classroom endpoints.
Deletion, retention, withdrawal, and account deactivation remain unresolved and fail closed.

unresolved_decisions.fail_closed: Do not execute membership request, approval, rejection, or retrieval endpoints until exact cardinality and cross-grade conflict behavior are approved.

unresolved_decisions.name: invite_cross_learner_reuse_policy
unresolved_decisions.fail_closed: Do not issue or resolve live invites. Duplicate same-command replay remains idempotent but does not decide cross-learner reuse.

unresolved_decisions.name: invite_expiry_duration
unresolved_decisions.fail_closed: Do not invent a duration or allow clients to choose policy.

unresolved_decisions.name: classroom_grade_change_after_membership
unresolved_decisions.fail_closed: No classroom update endpoint and no grade mutation after creation.

unresolved_decisions.name: profile_and_account_update_deactivation
unresolved_decisions.fail_closed: No update, deactivate, transfer, unlink, archive, or delete endpoint.

unresolved_decisions.name: retention_withdrawal_and_deletion
unresolved_decisions.fail_closed: No deletion automation, research export, pilot, or production authorization.

unresolved_decisions.name: invite_token_cryptographic_contract
unresolved_decisions.fail_closed: Do not invent token format, entropy, hash/KDF, QR encoding, or secret handling implementation in governance.

fail_closed_behavior: Only profile create/read and teacher-owned classroom create/read endpoints are executable in this limited scope.
Invite and membership tables may be implemented as neutral foundations, but their endpoints remain disabled with SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE until their named blockers are approved.
Reject all roles except LEARNER and TEACHER.
Reject profile-type changes and second-profile creation.
Reject Grade 1, Grade 4, and every grade other than GRADE_2 or GRADE_3.
Do not expose non-owned resources; use RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND where needed to prevent enumeration.
Do not infer multi-classroom, invite reuse, expiry, grade-change, deactivation, retention, or deletion behavior.
Do not create any learning session or scientific record.
prohibited_behavior: Session start, prepare, resume, pause, abandon, expire, or complete
Yass source, research wheel, or generator dependency

authorized_next_batch: Extend app_users only with immutable nullable-onboarding profile_type.
Reuse and minimally extend b_learners with name; do not create learner_profiles.
Reuse and constrain app_user_learner_links for one self-owned learner profile.
Create policy-gated classroom_invites and classroom_memberships persistence foundations.
Implement only the seven AUTHORIZED profile and classroom create/read endpoints.
Use existing authentication, stable error envelope, request IDs, idempotency, unit of work, audit, and REAL provenance foundations.

required_tests: Only LEARNER and TEACHER profile types are accepted; second profile and profile-type change fail.
Supabase subject maps uniquely to app_users; passwords, JWTs, and email copies are absent from persistence.
Learner profile atomically creates b_learners and exactly one owning app_user_learner_links row.
Teacher can create multiple classrooms; each classroom has exactly one owner and one allowed grade.
Learner cannot create classrooms; teacher cannot read another teacher's classroom; UUID possession does not authorize access.
Grade values outside GRADE_2 and GRADE_3 fail and learner profile creation cannot set grade.
All POST commands pass identical replay, body mismatch, concurrency, and rollback tests.
REAL provenance and audit fields are server-assigned; live TEST, SYNTHETIC, and IMPORTED provenance fails.
PII field allow-lists, token/password/log leakage, and response minimization tests pass.
Invite and membership schema constraints pass, while every policy-gated route is absent or returns fail-closed SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE without mutation.
Architecture guards prove no session, question, attempt, hint, progress, scientific, Yass, Component C, or Component 3 behavior was added.
Migration upgrade, downgrade, re-upgrade, no-drift, Docker non-root, no-source-mount, and PostgreSQL isolation checks pass.
exit_criteria: Only the authorized reuse/extensions and four new tables exist; no learner_profiles duplicate exists.
Only the seven AUTHORIZED endpoints are added and policy-gated endpoints remain non-executable.
All ownership, cross-account, grade, idempotency, audit, provenance, privacy, and isolation tests pass.
No password, raw JWT, raw invite token, research identifier, scientific field, or synthetic record enters live persistence, responses, or logs.
All prohibited learning and scientific behavior remains absent.
A separate closure review verifies implementation against this file before any invite or membership behavior is considered.

before_invite_or_membership_endpoints: product owner for learner multi-classroom and invite reuse
backend security owner for token and expiry contract

exact_next_task: Implement one governance-bound BE2 profile and classroom foundation batch against this authorization: schema reuse/extensions, teacher_profiles, classrooms, policy-gated invite/membership tables, and only the seven AUTHORIZED profile/classroom create/read endpoints. Do not implement invite or membership endpoints, learning sessions, or scientific behavior.
